content.text: {"stops":[{"poi_id":"p1","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m1","note":"Start with the torii tunnel before the crowds turn it into a slow procession."},{"poi_id":"p12","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"A thousand wooden kannon, all watching you try to count them."},{"poi_id":"p3","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"The stage hangs over the maples like a dare, and the view takes the bet."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p4","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m3","note":"Graze the stalls, then find the knife shop and watch the chestnut roaster work."},{"poi_id":"p15","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"Tofu done properly, in more shapes than you thought a bean could manage."},{"poi_id":"p7","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Walk slowly here; the old wooden facades reward the unhurried eye."},{"poi_id":"p13","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Lanterns, narrow lanes, and the sound of someone practising shamisen behind a screen."},{"poi_id":"p19","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"A calm, plant-based table that will not make the vegetarian explain themselves."}]}
Lanterns, gold, and vermilion wood — all the must-dos tucked in, shoes off, phone down, eyes up.
